technique: capture budget, whole pipeline, one frame at 1080x1920
basis: MEASURED: research-effects-arsenal.md constraint C7, the project's real capture rate
notes: This is the number every other row must fit inside. A shot that cannot hit it cannot ship. png throughput measured elsewhere at 1.8-11.0 fps.

technique: plain canvas2d scene, world plus type layer
basis: MEASURED: ART-DIRECTION-STANDARD-ADDENDUM-A1.md#A1.13, the s10 v3 build's seek number, ~3 ms/frame for a plain scene
notes: Measured on this project's own machine and rig. Everything below is expressed against this baseline.

technique: scene plus a 12-frame WebGL transition window
basis: MEASURED: ART-DIRECTION-STANDARD-ADDENDUM-A1.md#A1.13, ~1 ms/frame of extra seek time (both scene layers plus 2 texture uploads) on top of ~3 ms/frame
notes: A transition uploads two full-resolution canvases per frame, so judge it on the seek number, not the screenshot number. Keep the window at or under 14 frames.

technique: gl-transitions fade
basis: ESTIMATED from MEASURED 140 fps at 540x960 in docs/motion/fx/catalog.json, times the 4x pixel rule for 1080p
notes: The cheapest full-screen shader in the vendored corpus. 1080p figure is an estimate, not a measurement.

technique: circle-reveal (circleopen)
basis: ESTIMATED from MEASURED 132 fps at 540x960 in docs/motion/fx/catalog.json
notes: Suitable for a scene opener. Anchor the circle on the subject, not on the frame centre.

technique: Pixelize
basis: ESTIMATED from MEASURED 129.7 fps at 540x960 in docs/motion/fx/catalog.json
notes: Catalogue status is experimental; treat the look as a deliberate stylisation.

technique: rgb-glitch (radial chromatic aberration, glitch)
basis: ESTIMATED from MEASURED 121 fps at 540x960 in docs/motion/fx/catalog.json
notes: At 0.5-2 px displacement this is the cheapest lens character available; at 8 px it reads as a broken render.

technique: StereoViewer
basis: ESTIMATED from MEASURED 45.5 fps at 540x960 in docs/motion/fx/catalog.json
notes: Already at the top of the budget at 1080p; not for a sustained shot.

technique: noise-displace (domain-warped noise)
basis: ESTIMATED from MEASURED 82.7 fps at 540x960 in docs/motion/fx/catalog.json
notes: Affordable as a full-frame texture or a transition; keep it to one pass.

technique: displace-dissolve
basis: ESTIMATED from MEASURED 78.3 fps at 540x960 in docs/motion/fx/catalog.json
notes: A good world-to-world dissolve where the two frames share a texture.

technique: CrossZoom (zoom blur)
basis: MEASURED at 16.1 fps at 540x960 in docs/motion/fx/catalog.json, x4 for 1080p (ESTIMATED 1080p figure)
notes: At about 4 fps at 1080p this is a 3-5 frame accent at most. Never a sustained shot. The 540x960 fps itself is a measurement.

technique: LinearBlur
basis: MEASURED at 16.8 fps at 540x960 in docs/motion/fx/catalog.json, x4 for 1080p (ESTIMATED 1080p figure)
notes: Same ceiling as CrossZoom: 3-5 frames only.

technique: UV-slice shatter in one WebGL pass (glitch-class block displacement)
basis: ESTIMATED by analogy with the fade/circleopen class at 540x960; not measured for this specific shader
notes: Run `pa fx check` on the new shader before committing a shot to it.

technique: ACES-filmic tonemap, one fullscreen pass on the composited frame
basis: ESTIMATED: research-effects-arsenal.md R10, marked ESTIMATED by the researcher
notes: The Narkowicz 11-instruction fit. Apply it after the type layer so the type shares the response.

technique: vignette plus letterbox
basis: ESTIMATED: research-effects-arsenal.md ranked entry 10
notes: Cheap enough to run on every frame; required anyway for the >= 10% L* corner falloff rule.

technique: grain overlay by pre-rendered tile swap
basis: ESTIMATED: research-effects-arsenal.md R8, explicitly an estimate
notes: 6-10 tiles generated once, one tile per frame by index = frame % N. Never animate feTurbulence live.

technique: mesh-gradient background, 3-6 radial layers, full-screen repaint
basis: NOT MEASURED: research-effects-arsenal.md R7 says measure the full-screen repaint
notes: GPU-composited in principle, but a full-screen repaint per frame is exactly the case the researcher flagged as needing a measurement.

technique: live animated feTurbulence filter over a large area
basis: NOT MEASURED: research-effects-arsenal.md unverified note 5; SVG filters are CPU raster here
notes: Also non-deterministic under seek. Use the pre-rendered tile swap instead.

technique: ctx.filter blur on the background plane only
basis: NOT MEASURED: research-effects-arsenal.md unverified note 12 (ctx.filter blur cost at 1080x1920)
notes: Used for the depth-of-field differential; probe it before a whole film depends on it.

technique: canvas2D slice reveal, N=12 slices with staggered drawImage source rects
basis: ESTIMATED: research-effects-arsenal.md R11 calls it very safe at N=12
notes: Slice width must be kept visually constant across ratios: N = round(N0 * W / H).

technique: bokeh field, up to 30 sprites plus one layer blur
basis: ESTIMATED: research-effects-arsenal.md ranked entry 24, cheap if <= 30 sprites
notes: Alpha 0.06-0.18, size proportional to the depth key, one blur for the whole layer.

technique: dust motes, 20-40 sprites, seeded
basis: ESTIMATED: canvas2d arcs, no filter; the cost is dominated by the base scene
notes: Atmosphere must be drawn in front of and behind the subject.

technique: god rays, half-resolution occlusion buffer with 24-32 fixed radial taps
basis: NOT MEASURED: research-effects-arsenal.md ranked entry 22; params are unverified because the GPU Gems chapter body is JS-rendered
notes: Fixed tap count and no jitter, or it stops being deterministic. Use the pooled-shaft recipe (BTY-REC-022) when the budget is tight.

technique: halftone with a rotated screen angle
basis: NOT MEASURED: research-effects-arsenal.md ranked entry 21, cost unverified
notes: The glslify implementation's licence was not verified either; reimplement the idea rather than copying it.

technique: 3D LUT colour grade via sampler3D
basis: ESTIMATED, and it requires adopting three.js plus a locally generated .cube file
notes: Do not download a .cube; generate it from a formula so it is ours. The three.js adoption itself is a large, unmeasured commitment here.

technique: full-resolution bloom, 5 mips, kernel size array [6,10,14,18,22]
basis: NOT MEASURED but structurally derived from the UnrealBloomPass source (about 10 extra fullscreen blurs per frame)
notes: Use the quarter-resolution bright pass with 2 mips, or pre-blurred sprite glows.

technique: image to particles, 3-8k particles in canvas 2D
basis: ESTIMATED: research-effects-arsenal.md ranked entry 32; above 20k particles needs WebGL
notes: Phase each particle from a hash of its index so the field is reproducible from t.

technique: a three.js shot (real 3D, procedural PMREM environment, ACES, contact shadow)
basis: NOT MEASURED: research-effects-arsenal.md states three.js performance on this SwiftShader rig is completely unmeasured
notes: Budget at 4x the 540x960 number and prove the shot before writing it into a film. Adopt three.js only for shots that genuinely need 3D.

technique: temporal accumulation motion blur (AfterimagePass-style, damp 0.96)
basis: MEASURED-BY-SOURCE: the three.js AfterimagePass accumulates _textureOld and _textureComp across frames
notes: Not a cost problem, a correctness problem: seeking to frame 40 without rendering 0-39 gives a different image. A bounded 2-3 ghost blur computed by literally rendering t-1 and t-2 is allowed.

technique: GPGPU particle simulation with ping-pong framebuffers
basis: NOT MEASURED, and structurally stateful
notes: State carried between frames is not seek-safe. Reproduce the look with a closed-form curl-noise position field evaluated at t.

technique: scaling any 540x960 measurement to 1080x1920
basis: MEASURED pixel ratio: 1080x1920 has 4x the pixels of 540x960
notes: Every ESTIMATED 1080p figure in this file uses this rule. It is an assumption about how cost scales, not a measurement.

technique: canvas2D numeral run with a bidi isolate and ctx.direction = ltr
basis: MEASURED-BY-CONSTRUCTION: two extra string characters and one state assignment
notes: Required by the Persian numeral rule; there is no cheaper correct option.

technique: pre-baked chain integration (pa-chain integrate into a table)
basis: MEASURED-BY-DESIGN: pa-chain.mjs integrates ahead of time so seek stays a lookup
notes: This is the legal way to have physics-like secondary motion under the purity law.
